items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: the player piano of the James family when I lived on Kenyon Avenue as a boy

ctx.x: A few nights later, this friend of "Wild Bill's" came back to the Inn alone and said that he came especially to talk to Edgar Hayes. When it came time for us to have our nightly meal, this fellow came into the dining room and sat at the table with us and he did the talking.

There was a big record and music shop up town in Cincinnati on 6th Street by the name of [Chubb] Cub & Steinberg who had sponsored the orchestra that was playing at Castle Farm. This fellow told us that his name was Saughtercamp and that he was considered the best dance pianist in Cincinnati and some other towns in Ohio, but he had never heard a pianist who could play as much as Edgar Hayes.
